records.claimText: Japan's population aged 65 and over reached 36.24 million in 2026, equal to 29.6% of the total population and a record high; employment among people aged 65 and over also reached a record high.

Japan's industrial production index rose 0.5% month on month in May 2026 to 103.0, its second consecutive increase, while METI maintained the assessment that production was moving back and forth rather than in sustained expansion.
MLIT issued September 2026 guidelines to accelerate automation and remote operation of port cargo-handling equipment in response to labour shortages and continuity concerns in port logistics.
MLIT adopted a 2026 infrastructure AI implementation policy and interim physical-AI strategy for construction, aimed at implementation and productivity in infrastructure operations.
Japan relies on overseas imports for almost all oil and natural gas, with around 90% of crude oil imports sourced from the Middle East, creating an ongoing supply-security dependency.

BOJ payment and settlement statistics show BOJ-NET and the Zengin System continuing to operate at large scale; the 2025 baseline recorded 94,602 BOJ-NET current-account settlements per business day with average value of 232.6 trillion yen.
Japan's August 2026 CPI rose 1.9% year on year overall and 1.7% excluding fresh food, indicating ongoing price pressure even as headline inflation moderated.
Port automation is explicitly framed as a response to labour shortages threatening stable cargo-handling continuity.
records.reason: Supports adaptation/continuity context but not a complete whole-system P3 continuity mechanism.
